subject: biology
title: Through the Microscope
welcome_lead: Learn the parts of a light microscope and how to use one like a pro scientist.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on microscope parts and how to use a microscope.
final_note: You can now name microscope parts and use one to view tiny structures.

walkthroughs.body_html: The eyepiece is the lens you look through. The objective lens sits above the stage. The stage holds the slide. A light shines up through the sample.
Place the slide on the stage. Start with the lowest objective. Use the focus knob to bring the image into focus. Move to higher objectives for more detail.
Always carry by the arm and base. Keep lenses clean. Never let the objective touch the slide. Cover when not in use.
